messages:
mara.c: Heads-up — noticed a spike in owner flips around 12:05pm today. probably due to the routing splay window being too tight during surge. grabbing a quick sync before we roll anything.

samir: Can you paste the spike sample? is this HubSpot webhooks retrying or our enrichment lag?

mara.c: sample attached (short): 12:04:52 lead A -> owner1, 12:04:59 lead A -> owner2, 12:05:12 lead A -> owner3. enrichment service returned at 12:05:50 for same lead.

jess: ugh — that sounds like our rotation window (splay) was 5s and claim timeout 8s. If retries come in during splay, competing assign flow wins.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: current rollout health: enrichment-api v2.1 100% healthy, claim-service v1.8 experiencing 0.3% 500s last 15m.

alex.g: Quick thought: increase splay jitter to spread claims across 30–60s during high qps, and add short lease (15s) to avoid immediate reassigns. low-risk config change.

mara.c: I sketched config change:
# claim config
splay_window: 30  # was 5
splay_jitter_pct: 0.25
claim_lease_secs: 15
retry_backoff_ms: 500

samir: That looks sane. Two questions: 1) do we need a migration for existing in-flight claims? 2) any impact on SLA for hot leads (vip channel)?

jess: For in-flight nothing to migrate — lease applies on next claim event. For VIPs we should exclude them from splay (keep immediate assign). I recommend a simple rule: if lead.tags contains `vip` or `demo-schedule` skip splay.

mara.c: Agreed. I'll add a gating rule:
if lead.tags ∩ {"vip","demo-schedule"}: splay_window = 0
else: splay_window = config.splay_window

alex.g: can we flag any lead that reassigns >2 times within 60s to route to overflow-pool and create a ticket? helps ops triage.

ops-bot: incident-signal: created alert -> #support with key lead IDs when reassign_count > 2 within 60s.

samir: Plan: mara to push config change to staging, run 30min smoke with synthetic bursts, then small canary (10% traffic) tomorrow at 10:00am PT. jess will prepare VIP exclusion testcases. alex to add overflow alert.

mara.c: I'll open a PR and add the config toggle + rollout notes. tagging @jess @alex.g for tests.

jess: thanks — will add test matrix to the PR. will look at HubSpot webhook dedupe too, but config change likely fixes most flips. :thumbsup:

mara.c: ETA PR by EOD. if all green we'll schedule canary. thanks team!
